title: Planning, your way
intro: Whether you've planned every detail or you're just getting started, there's a package to carry your vision through to the last dance.

items.name: Month-of Wedding Coordination
items.tag: You plan, we take the reins
items.summary: Designed for couples who have planned their wedding but want a professional to step in during the final month and make sure everything comes together seamlessly.
features: Detailed review of your wedding plans and timeline
Management of the wedding day timeline
Coordination with the venue and wedding party
Wedding day setup and décor assistance
Troubleshooting and handling unexpected details throughout the day
Professional support so you can relax and enjoy your wedding day
items.goal: You've done the planning — now let ABailey Events take the reins and make sure your vision is carried out on your wedding day.

items.name: Full Wedding Planning
items.tag: From first idea to final dance
items.summary: Perfect for couples who want professional guidance from the beginning stages of planning all the way through their wedding day. ABailey Events works alongside you to bring your vision to life while managing the details, vendors, timeline and logistics along the way.
features: Full wedding planning from start to finish
Assistance with booking and managing vendors
Wedding theme, colour palette and styling guidance
Wedding day setup and décor assistance
Coordination of vendors and wedding party
Timeline management and cueing of key moments
items.goal: From the first idea to the final dance, ABailey Events handles the details so you can focus on enjoying the experience and celebrating your love.

custom.title: Custom quotes, always
custom.body: Every celebration is different. If you'd like something tailored to your day, we're happy to put together a custom quote.
